blocked_sentences: The Last Centurion — When you cast this spell from anywhere other than exile, exile it with three time counters on it. It gains suspend. Then investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

needs.what: a cast trigger on a permanent spell ("when you cast this spell", with a condition on the zone it was cast from: anything but exile) whose effect moves the spell itself from the stack to exile with N time counters and marks it suspended (gains suspend, 702.62), so it later ticks down and is cast free -- the creature version of Rousing Refrain's self-suspend, but performed by a triggered ability while the spell is still on the stack, followed by investigate
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the `suspends_itself` card-level rider is applied only on resolution and only for non-permanent spells (`stack.py` checks `not card.is_permanent`), so a creature spell can never use it; `spell_cast` has no self-source form for the card's own cast with a cast-from-zone condition, and no op in `reference` exiles a spell from the stack with time counters and grants suspend (`exile` moves permanents/cards, `suspend` is only a cast cost)
